content.title: Shopify Stock Falls After Earnings. Why Good Wasn’t Good Enough.
content.summary: Shopify  stock was slumping Tueday after third-quarter earnings failed to satisfy Wall Street as investors looked beyond better-than-expected revenue and gross merchandise volume.  Revenue surged 32% to $2.84 billion in the quarter, topping the consensus call for $2.76 billion among analysts polled by  FactSet  Gross merchandise volume from merchant customers rose 32% to $92 billion, topping the 28% gain to $89.12 billion Wall Street had projected.  Shopify stock declined 3.5% following the report Tuesday morning.

content.title: Wall Street Intensifies Scrutiny of Fraud After Spate of Loan Losses
content.summary: A string of alleged frauds by corporate borrowers is spurring a reckoning across Wall Street, sending bankers and investors scrambling to prevent future blowups.  Lenders are increasing due diligence and demanding a longer history of financial data from companies.  A group of the biggest names in banking, investment management and accounting have formed a task force that will take a deeper look at the nature of the problem and how to protect investors.
